display_name: The Red Oath of Ember Below

clergy.vestments: blackened mail draped in ember-red cords and soot-scribed skin strips
clergy.holy_symbol: split anvil leaking a tongue of flame

practices.dietary_restrictions: no cold food on holy days

cosmology.opposing_view_detail: Lawful powers are jailers who chain the soul to dead custom and call obedience holiness when it is only fear.
cosmology.notes: See §3.3 Alignment Cosmology Rules for the hard constraints governing this field.

pantheon.holy_symbol: broken chain laid on an anvil
pantheon.domains_summary: Patron of ruinous craft, liberating fire, and the smash of old limits.

pantheon.holy_symbol: crown of cinders over a black moon
pantheon.domains_summary: Goddess of violent courage, battle ecstasy, and the dark hour before victory.

pantheon.holy_symbol: black brand on a shard of bone
pantheon.domains_summary: Keeper of vengeance, grim foresight, and the dead who refuse to forgive.

pantheon.holy_symbol: road-mark cut through a snapped fetter
pantheon.domains_summary: Patron of escapes, raids, hard journeys, and fortune seized by the bold.

flavor_text.one_line: A furious dwarven war-faith that sanctifies vengeance, liberating flame, and the breaking of chains.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Red Oath was born among shattered holds and oath-feuds too bitter to cool. Its gods promise that no insult need be forgotten and no strong hand need bow before dead law. Priests of the faith bless forge work meant for war, stir frenzy before raids, and teach that the soul is judged in flame, then hurled back into the world until its grudges are either fulfilled or transcended in fire.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: When the first tyrant-gods sealed the deep roads, Varkhaz shattered his own anvil to make the sparks that became the rebel gods and the first avengers.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Break chains, answer blood-debt, honor strength proven in deed, despise cowardly submission, and reject Lawful jailers who sanctify obedience over truth.
